infant_form: A very young mythical elemental kitten in its first life stage: compact small body, slightly oversized rounded head, short soft legs, large glossy expressive eyes, small triangular ears, one simple fluffy tail, plush layered fur and a gentle curious expression. Anatomy is cute, coherent and stylized. The kitten may carry exactly one small lineage sigil on the forehead and one restrained elemental effect concentrated mainly around the tail, because those are stable element identity cues rather than mutations.
composition: Full body clearly visible from ears to paws and complete tail, front three-quarter view, calm natural pose, face and tail both readable. Use a pulled-back environmental camera rather than a close portrait. The kitten should occupy only about 38 to 42 percent of the image height and sit slightly below the visual center, with substantial scenery visible above, beside and behind it. Keep the kitten fully inside the frame with comfortable margins around ears, paws and tail. Use a premium mobile-game PetHome composition with strong environment depth, foreground, midground and background while keeping the kitten as the focal point.
forbidden_advanced_features: No advanced mutation marks beyond the single lineage sigil, no split tail, no glowing-paw mutation, no special iris-ring mutation, no guardian mane, no complex facial symbols, no heavy accessories, no wings, no armor and no multiple mutation effects.
